litanies.title: The Salt Litany of Three Becoming
litanies.text_body: three becomes one becomes none / and what was three remembers being one / and what was one remembers being three / and the witness keeps the count
litanies.mechanical_effect: On full hearing: +1 path:silence credit; +1 Notice from The Unnamed; substrate_practicing_word exposure event seeded for listener.
litanies.rite_kind: Recited at the salt vigil; spoken by Marrow-Saints when the
litanies.canonical_use: Recited at the salt vigil; spoken by Marrow-Saints when the fountain answers. Hearing the full four lines exposes substrate_practicing_word for the listener for 1d4 in-world days.

litanies.title: The Wave-Counter's Count
litanies.text_body: one for the drowned / one for the named / one for the witness who keeps the count / and one we do not say
litanies.mechanical_effect: On full hearing: +1 path:law credit; Helm Faith Meter +1 if listener is on civic business.
litanies.rite_kind: Opens Bell Court hearings concerning drowning deaths. The fo
litanies.canonical_use: Opens Bell Court hearings concerning drowning deaths. The fourth line is whispered, not spoken; whispering it aloud is a Court taboo (taboo_amend_ledger-adjacent).

litanies.title: What the Fountain Refuses
litanies.text_body: what is given cannot return / unless the giver is unmade also / and what is unmade is not given but remembered / and what is remembered cannot be given again
litanies.mechanical_effect: On full hearing: +1 path:silence; clarity +1 on first hearing only; subsequent hearings have no effect.
litanies.rite_kind: Whispered by the Listening Child at the dry fountain. Crucia
litanies.canonical_use: Whispered by the Listening Child at the dry fountain. Crucial to understanding the slice's central crisis (the fountain leaking upward = something is being unmade and remembered, not given back).

litanies.title: Practicing Word
litanies.text_body: first you ask / second you call / third the world answers in your voice / and the fourth answer is your own name returning
litanies.mechanical_effect: On full hearing near practicing water: substrate_practicing_word exposure event committed via state_diff; Authority +0.5 weight toward next canon-progression; Notice +1 from The Unnamed.
litanies.rite_kind: Spoken (or stuttered) by The Butcher Who Repeats during the
litanies.canonical_use: Spoken (or stuttered) by The Butcher Who Repeats during the repetition. The litany is the substrate_practicing_word pattern in litany form. Hearing all four lines while in the presence of practicing water binds the speaker into the substrate's witness chain.

litanies.title: Litany of the Marrow-Saint's Hand
litanies.text_body: this hand has been salt / this hand has been bone / this hand has held a child to the water / this hand has held the water to a child / and the hand knows which it was
litanies.mechanical_effect: On full hearing: enables the next healing-ritual or recovery-rite cast by a Marrow-Saint to operate at +1 effective level; +1 path:mercy credit on the listener if witnessed.
litanies.rite_kind: Spoken by Marrow-Saints before laying hands on a body (livin
litanies.canonical_use: Spoken by Marrow-Saints before laying hands on a body (living or drowned). Required by Drowned Church doctrine before any healing or recovery ritual. Refusal to speak it before laying hands is a doctrine_doc_salt_first_witness violation.

litanies.title: The Salt-Vigil Round
litanies.text_body: we keep the salt because the salt kept us / we keep the watch because the watch keeps the salt / we keep the name because the name keeps the watch / and when one of three breaks, the other two carry
litanies.mechanical_effect: Witnessing a complete round (3+ singers) grants Inspiration token to one listener at GM/World Director discretion; +1 Drowned Church faction reputation if listener participates.
litanies.rite_kind: Sung in round (overlapping voices) at the weekly salt vigil.
litanies.canonical_use: Sung in round (overlapping voices) at the weekly salt vigil. The round structure means each line is held by at least two singers at any moment. If a singer drops, the litany continues. The doctrinal point is that Greywake's faith does not depend on any single voice.

litanies.title: The Listing of the Names Not Spoken
litanies.text_body: the name we do not say of the Mother / the name we do not say of the Practicing Voice / the name we do not say of the Child Who Listens / the name we do not say of the one who will come after the Child / and the name we do not say because we do not yet know it
litanies.mechanical_effect: On full hearing: substrate_naming_taboo exposure event seeded for the listener for 1 in-world day; Authority +0.3 weight toward next canon-progression; +1 path:silence.
litanies.rite_kind: Recited at the annual remembrance vigil and at canon-events
litanies.canonical_use: Recited at the annual remembrance vigil and at canon-events of significance ≥ 4. The fifth line is the doctrinally crucial one — the Drowned Church explicitly leaves space for unnamed-as-yet divinities. This is how the Church accommodates The Unnamed without doctrinal crisis.

litanies.title: Bell-and-Inkwell
litanies.text_body: the bell strikes at the hour / the inkwell sits at the bench / between the bell and the inkwell the Court is the Court / and outside the bell and the inkwell the Court is nothing
litanies.mechanical_effect: Players who hear this litany at session opening gain legal-fiction knowledge: actions outside Court-time and Court-place are not Court-jurisdictional. May open new dialogue surfaces with NPCs who care about this distinction (lawyers, smugglers, escaped debtors).
litanies.rite_kind: Daily opening of Bell Court sessions. Defines the Court's ju
litanies.canonical_use: Daily opening of Bell Court sessions. Defines the Court's jurisdiction as temporal and spatial: only between the bell-strike and the inkwell does Court law apply. Outside those bounds, Court has no claim. (This is the Court's own self-limiting doctrine; it is also why street-level Greywake events often go uncounted.)

litanies.title: The Witness Clause
litanies.text_body: the witness names what the witness saw / the witness does not name what the witness believes / the witness does not name what the witness wishes / and what the witness wished is for the witness alone
litanies.mechanical_effect: If sworn before testifying, the witness's testimony is treated as canonical observation (event.severity may be elevated); refusing to swear leaves testimony as belief (rumor-track instead of canon-track).
litanies.rite_kind: Spoken by a witness before testimony in Bell Court. The lega
litanies.canonical_use: Spoken by a witness before testimony in Bell Court. The legal formula constrains testimony to observation, excluding inference and desire. The fourth line is a small mercy — the witness keeps their interior.

litanies.title: What the Ledger Records
litanies.text_body: what the ledger records is what was / what the ledger does not record is not / what the ledger misspells was misspelled / and what the ledger crossed out was crossed out, not removed
litanies.mechanical_effect: On full hearing: listeners who attempt to amend the visitor ledger receive Bell Court hostile-action prompt with +1 severity. Crossed-out names become legible to the listener for 1 in-world day (they can read what was 'removed').
litanies.rite_kind: Recited by Bell Court scribes when sealing the daily ledger.
litanies.canonical_use: Recited by Bell Court scribes when sealing the daily ledger. The doctrinal force: the Court treats the visitor ledger as canonically authoritative even where it errs. The fourth line is what permits the contradiction ledger to coexist with civic law: a cross-out is itself a record.

litanies.title: Salt Holds, Scrip Promises
litanies.text_body: salt holds where the day held / scrip promises what tomorrow may hold / the third speculation is the price / and the price is the salt and the promise together
litanies.mechanical_effect: If the player hears this litany on the day they trade scrip, the salt-scrip exchange rate is shown to them transparently at full precision (not bucketed). Otherwise scrip values are shown bucketed.
litanies.rite_kind: Opening of Tide League trading day. Recited by the senior Br
litanies.canonical_use: Opening of Tide League trading day. Recited by the senior Broker present. The litany names the League's pricing principle: the canonical price is set by the third speculation (per doc_third_speculation_is_canon), and that price is the combined value of salt-held and scrip-promised.

litanies.title: The Third Speculation
litanies.text_body: the first speculation is a hope / the second speculation is a counter / the third speculation is the price / and the fourth speculation is the lie that breaks the market
litanies.mechanical_effect: If a player publicly names four or more speculations on Tide League goods within a single scene, salt-scrip volatility_modifier increases by 0.15 (state_diff committed by State Manager). The litany is the Court's-eye-view warning of this consequence.
litanies.rite_kind: Closing of Tide League trading day. Recited as a warning to
litanies.canonical_use: Closing of Tide League trading day. Recited as a warning to apprentices: the canonical price is the third, not the fourth. Speculation beyond the third is doctrinally forbidden (taboo_speculate_after_third). The litany makes the rule remembered.

litanies.rite_kind: vigil_of_listening
litanies.title: What Remains After Naming
litanies.text_body: what is named does not always remain / what is unnamed has been remaining always

litanies.rite_kind: what_the_ledger_records
litanies.title: Clerk's Compline
litanies.text_body: we close at the seventh bell / what was entered remains entered / what was struck has the weight of the struck

litanies.rite_kind: witness_clause
litanies.title: Witness Clause (short form)
litanies.text_body: this witness records / this witness does not embellish / this witness's record is admissible

litanies.rite_kind: what_the_ledger_records
litanies.title: What the Warrant Does Not Say
litanies.text_body: the warrant names what it names / what the warrant does not name is not therefore innocent / it is the warrant that is silent

litanies.rite_kind: third_speculation
litanies.title: Third Speculation (closing)
litanies.text_body: the third speculation closes at twenty-five / the third speculation has always closed at twenty-five / what closes at twenty-five does not deepen the market

litanies.rite_kind: salt_scrip_oath
litanies.title: Courier's Oath
litanies.text_body: the envelope is sealed / what is sealed will be moved as sealed / the moving is what the league pays for

litanies.rite_kind: salt_scrip_oath
litanies.title: Audit Acceptance
litanies.text_body: the records are open / what the records show is what the league shows / what the league does not show is not the records' fault

litanies.rite_kind: salt_scrip_oath
litanies.title: The Weighing
litanies.text_body: everything weighs / most things weigh something specific / the broker holds the scale
